title: ttr-lexicon/v1 — alias / value / grounding-trigger data file
description: A lexicon data file in the defining repo's sibling data area (`lexicon/aliases/*.lex.yaml`, `lexicon/values/*.lex.yaml`, `lexicon/grounding/*.lex.yaml`). RV-36..38, RV-42; contracts §2. Entry KIND is not declared here — it is derived from the target class (RV-38).

schema.description: Ledger id. Must equal the id of the schema the file is validated against.

defaults.description: Per-file defaults. A term's own `lang`/`method` always wins.

lang.description: BCP-47-lite: a single language or the both-languages form `cs|en`.

method.description: Match method. TYPOS carries its edit budget inline: TYPOS(1)..TYPOS(3).

target.description: Any model-graph ref (`er.*`, `md.*`, member refs), an `op:` ref, or a `ground:` class ref (RV-42). Existence of a MODEL ref is checked at compile time against the model snapshot, not here — but the `ground:` kind vocabulary IS closed (chrono | money | geo), because it names a kernel that must load the slice.
